rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 "Phase 1: Run the curated skill on your feature and save the map" (lines 22-42): the header promises two actions — run the skill on your feature, and save the map. The chunk's actual content (lines 24-41) only checks which skills are installed: the `/skills` command, then a prompt asking Claude to list installed skills, storage location, and context-load status. Nothing in this chunk invokes the skill on the student's feature or saves anything; that happens in the NEXT chunk, "Point the skill at your feature" (lines 43-56), under a differently-worded header.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Retitle chunk 2 to what it delivers (e.g. "Phase 1: Confirm the skill is on hand") or fold the invoke-and-save prompt into this chunk so the header's promise is kept here.
